title: Renewals Desk Note: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Expiration Notices
content:
Every Commercial Natural Gas Supply agreement with a term receives two expiration notices: an initial renewal notice and a final options notice. Commercial gas renewal notices are issued only on an active agreement with a term, as the agreement record shows.

## When each notice is compliant

- **Initial renewal notice.** Compliant when its notice date falls no earlier than the plan's earliest initial notice point and no later than the plan's latest initial notice point, each counted in calendar days before the contract end date.
- **Final options notice.** Compliant when its notice date falls no later than the plan's latest final options notice point, counted in calendar days before the contract end date, and after the initial notice.

## What each notice says

Each notice states the plan and the price offered for renewal, and that the agreement otherwise rolls to the monthly index plan.

## Withdrawn wording

The clause "where the two notices differ, the final options notice governs" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and may not be applied.

## Boundary dates (hypothetical contract end date 2025-12-31, with the 90, 60 and 30 calendar day points of the plan schedule)

| Notice | Notice date | Days before 2025-12-31 | Compliant? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Initial renewal notice | 2025-10-01 | 91 | No, earlier than 90 days |
| Initial renewal notice | 2025-10-02 | 90 | Yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 2025-11-01 | 60 | Yes |
| Initial renewal notice | 2025-11-02 | 59 | No, later than 60 days |
| Final options notice, issued after the initial notice | 2025-12-01 | 30 | Yes |
| Final options notice, issued after the initial notice | 2025-12-02 | 29 | No, later than 30 days |

## Basis question

**Does a month-to-month Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreement receive expiration notices?** No. Expiration notices are issued only on an active agreement with a term.
